docs.title: ⚡ BlueHellStats Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for BlueHellStats (also known as BlueHellEssence), the enterprise-grade statistics tracking, leaderboard visualization, in-world 3D podium, and automated seasonal tournament engine designed exclusively for Paper 1.21+ Minecraft servers.

docs.title: 💡 Architecture & Philosophy
docs.text: BlueHellStats is engineered following Pragmatic Clean Architecture: 1. The Bukkit Tick Loop (20 TPS) is Sacred: All disk I/O, network communication, database reads/writes, dirty delta flushes, and rank sortings are strictly offloaded to asynchronous background worker pools. 2. Immutability by Default: All domain entities are represented by immutable Java 21 Records (StatDefinition, PlayerProfile, LeaderboardEntry, PodiumConfig). 3. Hardened Security: Anti-dupe GUI pipelines cancel events at HIGHEST priority, blocking hotbar swapping, item injection, drag duplication, and macro spam. 4. Resilient Network Synchronization: Two-phase distributed lock barrier prevents race conditions and duplicate reward deliveries across multi-server proxy environments.

docs.title: Guía de Gobernanza Arquitectónica y Estándares de Ingeniería
docs.text: Proyecto: BlueHellEssence Plataforma: Paper 1.21.1+ (Java 21) Estándar: Clean Architecture Pragmática & Concurrencia Asíncrona

docs.title: 1. Principios Inmutables del Proyecto
docs.text:
1. El Hilo Principal (Tick Loop de 20 TPS) es Sagrado:
  2. Cero I/O (JDBC, archivos, HTTP, cómputo masivo) en el hilo principal de Bukkit.

  3. Cualquier interacción con bases de datos debe ejecutarse en el pool secundario (BlueHell-DB-Worker) mediante CompletableFuture<T>.

  4. Conceptos antes que Código (KISS & YAGNI):

  5. No implementar complejidad accidental (parsers innecesarios, abstracciones dogmáticas 1-a-1 sin polimorfismo real).

  6. El código debe ser comprensible, modular y directo.

  7. Inmutabilidad y Java 21:

  8. Todo modelo de datos que represente un estado congelado debe ser un Java Record (StatDefinition, LeaderboardEntry, Milestone).
  9. Prohibido retener referencias a entidades vivas de Bukkit (Player, Entity) dentro de colecciones persistentes. Usar siempre UUID.

docs.title: 2. Mapa de Capas y Responsabilidades
docs.text:
com.dev.bluehell
├── core/
│   ├── condition/           # Validadores desacoplados de condiciones (StatConditionValidator)
│   ├── config/              # Lectura y tipado estricto de YAMLs (ConfigManager, DatabaseConfig)
│   ├── database/            # Conexión HikariCP, schema migrations y lifecycle (DatabaseManager)
│   ├── event/               # Despachador dinámico y MethodHandles precompilados (DynamicEventRegistry)
│   └── message/             # Internacionalización MiniMessage desacoplada (MessageService)
├── gui/                     # Capa de presentación: Holders, Menús YAML, Paginador y Anti-Dupe
├── model/                   # Records inmutables y Enums de dominio puro (PlayerProfile, StatDefinition)
├── podium/                  # Proveedores de estatuas desacoplados (ArmorStand, Citizens, FancyNpcs)
├── season/                  # Sub-dominio de torneos estacionales, rollover y bloqueo distribuido
├── storage/                 # Puerto (StatRepository) y Adaptador ANSI SQL (SqlStatRepository)
├── service/                 # Servicios de negocio, cache en RAM y write-behind (StatService, PlayerProfileService)
├── listener/                # Thin Listeners: validación rápida y delegación a servicios
├── command/                 # Manejo modular de comandos y autocompletado (TopCommand, AdminStatCommand)
└── hook/                    # Integraciones opcionales (WorldGuard, DecentHolograms, PlaceholderAPI)

docs.title: Reglas de Dependencia entre Capas:
docs.text:
• model no depende de nadie.
  • storage solo interactúa con DatabaseManager y expone métodos que retornan CompletableFuture.
  • service inyecta dependencias por constructor. Nunca usa getInstance() estáticos.
  • listener es delgado: cancela eventos inválidos, extrae parámetros y delega al servicio.

docs.title: 3. Protocolo de Persistencia y Concurrencia (Write-Behind Cache)
docs.text:
Para garantizar 0 micro-lags en servidores de alto tráfico:

  1. Mutación en Caliente:
  2. Cuando un jugador incrementa una estadística, la mutación ocurre en memoria RAM (playerStatsCache) en menos de 10 nanosegundos.

  3. El delta acumulado se registra en dirtyDeltas.

  4. Drenado Periódico Asíncrono:

  5. Un scheduler asíncrono toma un snapshot de dirtyDeltas cada $N$ segundos y ejecuta un executeBatch() transaccional en PostgreSQL/SQLite.

  6. Si un jugador se desconecta (PlayerQuitEvent), sus deltas pendientes se descargan de inmediato y su sesión en RAM se limpia para evitar memory leaks.

  7. Cierre Seguro (onDisable):

  8. En el apagado del servidor, StatService.shutdown() realiza el volcado de los deltas restantes, el ExecutorService espera a que las tareas pendientes terminen (awaitTermination) y finalmente se cierra el pool de HikariDataSource.

docs.title: 4. Gobernanza para Añadir Nuevas Estadísticas y Eventos
docs.text:
Cuando se desee incorporar un nuevo tipo de evento (ej. daño infligido, pociones lanzadas, tiempo jugado):

  1. Enum: Agregar la constante en model/StatEventType.java.
  2. Listener:
  3. Abrir listener/DynamicStatListener.java.
  4. Crear el método @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true).
  5. Validar las condiciones específicas (ej. tipo de poción, daño mínimo).
  6. Invocar statService.recordIncrement(player, def, amount).
  7. Documentación: Actualizar stats.yml con el ejemplo comentado.

docs.title: 5. Reglas de Git y Commits
docs.text:
• Utilizar Conventional Commits:
  • feat: add support for player damage stat event
  • fix: resolve stale delta flush on unexpected server stop
  • refactor: extract requirement evaluation logic
  • Cero atribuciones de IA o co-authored-by en los commits.

docs.title: Guía de Uso, Configuración y Despliegue (Walkthrough)
docs.text: Plugin: BlueHellEssence Versión: 1.3.0 Requisitos: Paper 1.21.1+ | Java 21 | SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB o PostgreSQL

docs.title: 1. Instalación Rápida
docs.text:
1. Compilar el proyecto ejecutando: 
    mvn clean package
  2. Copiar el archivo generado en target/BlueHellEssence-1.3.0.jar dentro de la carpeta plugins/ de tu servidor Paper.
  3. Iniciar el servidor para que se generen los archivos config.yml, stats.yml, seasons.yml y la carpeta menus/.

docs.title: Modo Servidor Individual (SQLite - Local)
docs.text:
Por defecto, sin necesidad de instalar ningún servidor de base de datos externo: 

database:
  type: SQLITE
  sqlite:
    file: "bluehell.db"

docs.title: Modo Servidor o Network con MySQL / MariaDB (phpMyAdmin / cPanel / Pterodactyl)
docs.text:
Recomendado para servidores de hosting tradicionales y networks BungeeCord / Velocity: 

database:
  type: MYSQL # o MARIADB
  mysql:
    host: "localhost"
    port: 3306
    database: "bluehell"
    username: "root"
    password: "tu_password_segura"
    ssl: false

docs.title: Modo Network Empresarial con PostgreSQL (Alto Rendimiento)
docs.text:
Para networks grandes con sincronización instantánea LISTEN/NOTIFY y bloqueos distribuidos: 

database:
  type: POSTGRESQL
  postgresql:
    host: "10.0.0.5"
    port: 5432
    database: "bluehell"
    username: "network_user"
    password: "tu_password_segura"
    ssl: false

docs.title: 3. Configuración Dinámica de Estadísticas (stats.yml)
docs.text:
Cada estadística es declarativa y altamente personalizable:

stats:
  diamonds_mined:
    display-name: "<aqua>Diamantes Picados</aqua>"
    event: BLOCK_BREAK
    increment: 1
    cooldown-ms: 0
    conditions:
      materials:
        - DIAMOND_ORE
        - DEEPSLATE_DIAMOND_ORE
      game-modes:
        - SURVIVAL
      ignore-silk-touch: true # No cuenta si se pica con Toque de Seda
      world-mode: WHITELIST
      worlds:
        - world
    multipliers:
      "bluehell.multiplier.vip": 2.0 # Si el jugador tiene este permiso, suma x2
    milestones:
      - threshold: 100
        message: "<green>¡Alcanzaste 100 diamantes picados!</green>"
        broadcast: "<gold>¡<player> alcanzó el hito de 100 diamantes picados!</gold>"
        commands:
          - "give %player% diamond 5"
    season-rewards:

        - "eco give %player% 25000"
        - "give %player% diamond_block 10"
        - "broadcast <gold>[TEMPORADA]</gold> <yellow>%player%</yellow> dominó la minería con <aqua>%score%</aqua> diamantes!"
      2:
        - "eco give %player% 15000"
      3:
        - "eco give %player% 7500"

    display-name: "<red>Asesinatos PvP</red>"
    event: ENTITY_KILL
    increment: 1
    conditions:
      entities:
        - PLAYER
      game-modes:
        - SURVIVAL

        - "eco give %player% 50000"
      2:
        - "eco give %player% 25000"

docs.title: 5. Comandos de Administrador
docs.text:
Permiso requerido: bluehell.admin (por defecto asignado a operadores).

  • "add": Suma una cantidad a la estadística del jugador. /bhe add <jugador> <stat> <cantidad>
  • "set": Asigna un valor exacto a la estadística del jugador. /bhe set <jugador> <stat> <valor>
  • "reset": Restablece la estadística del jugador a 0. /bhe reset <jugador> <stat>
  • "profile": Abre el menú GUI de inspección de perfil multi-estadística de cualquier jugador. /bhe profile [jugador]
  • "podium create": Genera un podio 3D en las coordenadas y orientación del admin. /bhe podium create <stat> <1|2|3> [id]
  • "podium remove": Elimina un podio específico por su ID o todos los podios de una stat. /bhe podium remove <id|stat>
  • "podium list": Lista todos los podios físicos registrados y sus coordenadas. /bhe podium list
  • "podium refresh": Fuerza el refresco visual inmediato de los podios en el mundo. /bhe podium refresh [id]
  • "holo create": Genera un holograma flotante de tabla de clasificación con DecentHolograms. /bhe holo create <stat> [filas] [nombre]
  • "holo remove": Elimina un holograma por nombre o estadística. /bhe holo remove <nombre|stat>
  • "reload": Recarga los archivos de configuración (config.yml, stats.yml, seasons.yml, menus/*.yml) y recalcula las tablas de clasificación en caliente. /bhe reload

docs.title: Comandos de Temporadas (/season)
docs.text:
Permiso administrativo: bluehell.season.admin

  • /season status: Muestra el estado de la temporada actual y cuenta regresiva.
  • /season start <nombre> [duración]: Inicia una nueva temporada (ej. /season start "Verano 2026" 30d).
  • /season end: Finaliza la temporada activa.
  • /season rollover [nombre] [duración]: Ejecuta el cierre de temporada en 2 fases con cálculo de podios, entrega de premios Top-3 y apertura de la siguiente temporada.
  • /season claim: Reclama manualmente las recompensas estacionales pendientes (también se reclaman solas al entrar al servidor).

docs.title: 6. Comandos de Jugador
docs.text:
• /top: Abre el Salón de la Fama (Hub general de categorías configuradas en menus/hub.yml).
  • /top <stat_id>: Salta directamente a la visualización de la estadística especificada (ej. /top diamonds_mined).
  • /top profile [jugador]: Abre la GUI de perfil personal o de otro jugador mostrando todas sus estadísticas y rangos actuales (bluehell.profile).
  • /halloffame (alias /hof): Abre el navegador interactivo de temporadas pasadas y podios históricos.

docs.title: Protección Anti-Dupe Integrada:
docs.text:
1. Cancelación Inmediata: Todo click o arrastre (InventoryClickEvent, InventoryDragEvent) dentro de las GUIs se cancela en la máxima prioridad (HIGHEST).
  2. Bloqueo de Inyección: Shift-click y hotbar keys (1-9) desde el inventario del jugador quedan terminantemente bloqueados.
  3. Debouncer Anti-Macro: 150ms de enfriamiento por jugador para evitar abuso de autoclickers en transiciones de menús.

docs.title: 8. Podios Físicos 3D en el Mundo (ArmorStand, Citizens & FancyNpcs)
docs.text:
El sistema de podios (podiums.yml) renderiza en tiempo real a los jugadores líderes del ranking sobre bloques físicos en el mundo:

  • Proveedores Soportados:
  • ARMOR_STAND: Nativo de Paper 1.21 sin dependencias externas. Usa cabezas con texturas del jugador y armaduras con tintes de rango.
  • CITIZENS: Soporte completo para Citizens 2 con traits y /npc pose.
  • FANCY_NPCS: Soporte para FancyNpcs 2.10+ / 2.12+.
  • Cartel TextDisplay Billboard: Todos los proveedores spawnan un TextDisplay flotante Paper 1.21 que mira automáticamente a los jugadores y muestra el puesto, nombre y puntaje.
  • Manejo de Poses en FancyNpcs: En FancyNpcs las poses son atributos: 
    /npc attribute bhe_podium_<stat>_<rank> set pose <standing|crouching|sleeping|swimming|sitting>
  • Compatibilidad Upstream: BlueHellEssence incluye un hotfix en FancyNpcsStatueProvider que inyecta automáticamente el atributo faltante custom_model para evitar el NullPointerException interno de versiones 2.10.x.

docs.title: 9. Motor de Eventos Custom (Zero-Overhead Dynamic Events)
docs.text:
Permite interceptar eventos de cualquier plugin de terceros (ej. torretas, jobs, dungeons) sin necesidad de agregar dependencias Maven en compilación:

  1. Resolución en Arranque: MethodHandleChain compila las rutas de métodos getter a MethodHandle de la JVM en el inicio del plugin.
  2. Cero Reflexión en Runtime: Durante el juego, la invocación de métodos se ejecuta a velocidad directa de bytecode sin llamar a Method.invoke().
  3. Registro Bukkit Nativo: DynamicEventRegistry conecta dinámicamente con Bukkit usando un EventExecutor de alta prioridad.

docs.title: 10. Pruebas y Verificación
docs.text:
El proyecto cuenta con 301 pruebas unitarias e integrales que garantizan: - Persistencia asíncrona segura con HikariCP y transacciones batch. - Ausencia de bloqueos o race conditions en el tick loop principal. - Integridad anti-dupe en GUIs e inmutabilidad de modelos de dominio.

Ejecutar la suite completa: 

mvn clean test

docs.title: 🔌 Zero-Overhead Dynamic Custom Event Engine
docs.text: BlueHellStats features an event interception engine that allows you to hook and track events emitted by any 3rd-party plugin (e.g. custom turrets, slimefun machines, jobs, custom bosses) without having to add compile-time Maven dependencies.

docs.title: 🚀 Configuration Syntax (stats.yml)
docs.text:
Set event: CUSTOM and declare the custom_event_data block:

stats:
  turrets_placed:
    display-name: "<yellow>Turrets Placed</yellow>"
    event: CUSTOM
    increment: 1
    custom_event_data:
      event: "dt.ajneb97.api.TurretPlaceEvent"
      player_variable: "getPlayer()"
      variables_to_capture:
        - "%world%;getLocation().getWorld().getName()"
        - "%turret_type%;getTurretType()"
      conditions:
        - "%world% equals world"
        - "%turret_type% equals LASER"

docs.title: ⚙️ Configuration Properties
docs.text: Property Description Example event The fully-qualified Java class name of the event. "dt.ajneb97.api.TurretPlaceEvent" player_variable Method chain returning the Player performing the event. "getPlayer()" or "getEntity()" variables_to_capture List of <placeholder>;<getter_method_path>. "%world%;getLocation().getWorld().getName()" conditions Logic checks comparing captured placeholders. "%world% equals world", "%level% >= 5"

docs.title: ⚡ Technical Architecture: Why is it Lag-Free?
docs.text:
Traditional dynamic event reflection in Bukkit plugins uses java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(), which causes significant overhead and garbage allocation.

BlueHellStats eliminates this: 1. Boot Compilation via MethodHandleChain: During server startup or /bhe reload, the method paths (e.g. getLocation().getWorld().getName()) are parsed and compiled into high-performance java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles linked directly to the JVM call site. 2. Native Bukkit EventExecutor: The event listener registers directly into Bukkit's HandlerList via pluginManager.registerEvent(), bypassing heavy listener proxying. 3. Bytecode Invocation ($O(1)$): When the event fires, methods are invoked through pre-bound MethodHandle.invokeExact() / invoke(), running at near-native compiled Java speed.

docs.title: 🎨 GUI Customization & Anti-Dupe Architecture
docs.text: All user interfaces in BlueHellStats are declarative, customizable via YAML files inside plugins/BlueHellEssence/menus/, and built with enterprise-grade anti-dupe security.

docs.title: 🛡️ Anti-Dupe Security & HCI Design
docs.text:
Virtual menus in Minecraft can be susceptible to item duplication and ghost item glitches if poorly designed. BlueHellStats employs a multi-tiered security model:

  1. Priority Cancellation: All InventoryClickEvent and InventoryDragEvent occurrences in any plugin menu are cancelled at EventPriority.HIGHEST.
  2. Hotbar Swap & Injection Shield: Number key swaps (1-9), shift-clicks, off-hand swaps (F), and double-clicks are completely blocked.
  3. Macro Debouncing: An internal 150ms per-player debouncer prevents autoclicker race conditions during menu transitions.
  4. PDC Navigation Routing: Buttons store routing metadata in Paper's PersistentDataContainer (PDC), never relying on mutable item display names or lore.

docs.title: 🗿 In-World 3D Podiums Guide
docs.text: BlueHellStats allows you to spawn physical 3D podium statues directly in the Minecraft world to honor top contenders in real-time.

docs.title: 🎨 Supported Podium Providers
docs.text:
Configure the podium type per entry in podiums.yml:

podiums:
  diamonds_mined_1:
    stat: "diamonds_mined"
    rank: 1
    type: FANCY_NPCS # Options: ARMOR_STAND, CITIZENS, FANCY_NPCS

docs.title: 🔒 Two-Phase Rollover Barrier
docs.text: When a season expires (either automatically or via /season rollover): 1. Phase 1: Freeze & Distributed Lock: The coordinating node acquires a database-level distributed lock. Active score increments are temporarily frozen in RAM to ensure an uncorrupted snapshot. 2. Phase 2: Archive & Reward Queuing: The top players for each stat are immortalized into the bh_hall_of_fame table. Reward commands are queued into the bh_pending_rewards queue for Top 1, 2, and 3 players. 3. Phase 3: Activation & Resumption: A new active season ID is generated, stats for the new season are initialized, and live score increments resume.

docs.title: ⚡ Write-Behind Caching Architecture
docs.text: To guarantee that the Bukkit tick thread is never stalled: 1. In-Memory Mutations: When players break blocks, kill mobs, or trigger stats, their score delta is accumulated into a local concurrent RAM cache (dirtyDeltas) in nanoseconds. 2. Periodic Batch Flushing: Every flush-interval-seconds (default: 20s), an asynchronous background worker drains dirty deltas and sends batch SQL statements (executeBatch()) within a single database transaction. 3. Session Flush on Disconnect: When a player disconnects (PlayerQuitEvent), any pending uncommitted delta is immediately flushed asynchronously to ensure zero stat loss. 4. Clean Server Shutdown: On onDisable(), the plugin blocks gracefully until all pending database writes finish before closing the HikariCP connection pool.

docs.title: 🚀 Quick Start Guide
docs.text: This guide walks you through installing and configuring BlueHellStats on a Paper 1.21+ server.

docs.title: 📋 Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Server Platform: Paper, Purpur, or any modern Paper fork running Minecraft 1.21.1+.
  • Java Runtime: Java 21 or newer (OpenJDK / Temurin 21 recommended).
  • Optional Integrations:
  • PlaceholderAPI (for chat, scoreboard, and tablist placeholders)
  • Citizens or FancyNpcs (for in-world 3D player podium NPCs)
  • DecentHolograms (for floating spawn leaderboard holograms)
  • WorldGuard (for region-specific stat tracking like PvP arenas)
  • Vault (for economy commands in seasonal rewards and milestones)

docs.title: 📦 Installation Steps
docs.text:
1. Download: Obtain the latest BlueHellEssence-1.3.0.jar from Releases.
  2. Deploy: Place the .jar into your server's plugins/ folder.
  3. Boot Server: Start your server once to allow BlueHellStats to create its configuration folder and default files: 
    plugins/BlueHellEssence/
├── config.yml
├── seasons.yml
├── stats.yml
├── podiums.yml
├── messages/
│   ├── messages_en.yml
│   └── messages_es.yml
└── menus/
    ├── hub.yml
    ├── top.yml
    └── profile.yml
  4. Choose Database: By default, BlueHellStats runs on SQLite (bluehell.db), requiring zero setup. If you run a network, see Database Configuration.
  5. Reload Configs: Run /bhe reload to apply any changes in real time without restarting the server.

docs.title: ⌨️ Commands & Permissions Reference
docs.text: All commands support tab-completion, permission checks, and localization messages.

docs.title: 👥 Player Commands
docs.text: Command Permission Description /top bluehell.top Opens the main categories leaderboard hub (menus/hub.yml). /top <stat> bluehell.top Directly opens the leaderboard for a specific category (menus/top.yml). /top profile [player] bluehell.profile Opens the multi-stat detail profile GUI for yourself or another player. /halloffame (alias /hof) bluehell.hof Opens the historical browser of past seasons and podium winners. /season info bluehell.season.info View active season duration and remaining time. /season claim bluehell.season.claim Manually claim pending seasonal rewards.

docs.text:
Master permission: bluehell.admin (granted to operators by default).

Command Description /bhe add <player> <stat> <amount> Increment a player's score by the given amount. /bhe set <player> <stat> <amount> Set a player's score to an exact number. /bhe reset <player> <stat> Reset a player's stat to 0. /bhe profile [player] View any player's multi-stat profile GUI as administrator. /bhe reload Hot-reload all configurations, menus, and stats without server reboot.

docs.title: 🗿 Podium Sub-commands (/bhe podium)
docs.text: Sub-command Description /bhe podium create <stat> <1\|2\|3> [id] Spawn a 3D in-world podium statue at your exact location and yaw. /bhe podium remove <id\|stat> Remove a specific podium statue by ID or all podiums of a stat. /bhe podium list List all active 3D podiums and coordinates. /bhe podium refresh [id] Force immediate visual re-render of podium statues and billboards.

Permission: bluehell.season.admin

Command Description /season status Display active season details, start/end dates, and barrier state. /season start <number> <name> [duration] Force start a new season (e.g. /season start 2 "Winter Cup" 30d). /season end Force terminate the active season. /season rollover [number] [name] [duration] Execute atomic Two-Phase Rollover Barrier immediately. /season resetall confirm Master administrative reset back to Season #1 (wipes history).

docs.title: Guía de Gobernanza Arquitectónica y Estándares de Ingeniería
docs.text: Proyecto: BlueHellEssence Plataforma: Paper 1.21.1+ (Java 21) Estándar: Clean Architecture Pragmática & Concurrencia Asíncrona

docs.title: 1. Principios Inmutables del Proyecto
docs.text:
1. El Hilo Principal (Tick Loop de 20 TPS) es Sagrado:
  2. Cero I/O (JDBC, archivos, HTTP, cómputo masivo) en el hilo principal de Bukkit.

  3. Cualquier interacción con bases de datos debe ejecutarse en el pool secundario (BlueHell-DB-Worker) mediante CompletableFuture<T>.

  4. Conceptos antes que Código (KISS & YAGNI):

  5. No implementar complejidad accidental (parsers innecesarios, abstracciones dogmáticas 1-a-1 sin polimorfismo real).

  6. El código debe ser comprensible, modular y directo.

  7. Inmutabilidad y Java 21:

  8. Todo modelo de datos que represente un estado congelado debe ser un Java Record (StatDefinition, LeaderboardEntry, Milestone).
  9. Prohibido retener referencias a entidades vivas de Bukkit (Player, Entity) dentro de colecciones persistentes. Usar siempre UUID.

docs.title: 2. Mapa de Capas y Responsabilidades
docs.text:
com.dev.bluehell
├── core/
│   ├── condition/           # Validadores desacoplados de condiciones (StatConditionValidator)
│   ├── config/              # Lectura y tipado estricto de YAMLs (ConfigManager, DatabaseConfig)
│   ├── database/            # Conexión HikariCP, schema migrations y lifecycle (DatabaseManager)
│   ├── event/               # Despachador dinámico y MethodHandles precompilados (DynamicEventRegistry)
│   └── message/             # Internacionalización MiniMessage desacoplada (MessageService)
├── gui/                     # Capa de presentación: Holders, Menús YAML, Paginador y Anti-Dupe
├── model/                   # Records inmutables y Enums de dominio puro (PlayerProfile, StatDefinition)
├── podium/                  # Proveedores de estatuas desacoplados (ArmorStand, Citizens, FancyNpcs)
├── season/                  # Sub-dominio de torneos estacionales, rollover y bloqueo distribuido
├── storage/                 # Puerto (StatRepository) y Adaptador ANSI SQL (SqlStatRepository)
├── service/                 # Servicios de negocio, cache en RAM y write-behind (StatService, PlayerProfileService)
├── listener/                # Thin Listeners: validación rápida y delegación a servicios
├── command/                 # Manejo modular de comandos y autocompletado (TopCommand, AdminStatCommand)
└── hook/                    # Integraciones opcionales (WorldGuard, DecentHolograms, PlaceholderAPI)

docs.title: Reglas de Dependencia entre Capas:
docs.text:
• model no depende de nadie.
  • storage solo interactúa con DatabaseManager y expone métodos que retornan CompletableFuture.
  • service inyecta dependencias por constructor. Nunca usa getInstance() estáticos.
  • listener es delgado: cancela eventos inválidos, extrae parámetros y delega al servicio.

docs.title: 3. Protocolo de Persistencia y Concurrencia (Write-Behind Cache)
docs.text:
Para garantizar 0 micro-lags en servidores de alto tráfico:

  1. Mutación en Caliente:
  2. Cuando un jugador incrementa una estadística, la mutación ocurre en memoria RAM (playerStatsCache) en menos de 10 nanosegundos.

  3. El delta acumulado se registra en dirtyDeltas.

  4. Drenado Periódico Asíncrono:

  5. Un scheduler asíncrono toma un snapshot de dirtyDeltas cada $N$ segundos y ejecuta un executeBatch() transaccional en PostgreSQL/SQLite.

  6. Si un jugador se desconecta (PlayerQuitEvent), sus deltas pendientes se descargan de inmediato y su sesión en RAM se limpia para evitar memory leaks.

  7. Cierre Seguro (onDisable):

  8. En el apagado del servidor, StatService.shutdown() realiza el volcado de los deltas restantes, el ExecutorService espera a que las tareas pendientes terminen (awaitTermination) y finalmente se cierra el pool de HikariDataSource.

docs.title: 4. Gobernanza para Añadir Nuevas Estadísticas y Eventos
docs.text:
Cuando se desee incorporar un nuevo tipo de evento (ej. daño infligido, pociones lanzadas, tiempo jugado):

  1. Enum: Agregar la constante en model/StatEventType.java.
  2. Listener:
  3. Abrir listener/DynamicStatListener.java.
  4. Crear el método @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true).
  5. Validar las condiciones específicas (ej. tipo de poción, daño mínimo).
  6. Invocar statService.recordIncrement(player, def, amount).
  7. Documentación: Actualizar stats.yml con el ejemplo comentado.

docs.title: 5. Reglas de Git y Commits
docs.text:
• Utilizar Conventional Commits:
  • feat: add support for player damage stat event
  • fix: resolve stale delta flush on unexpected server stop
  • refactor: extract requirement evaluation logic
  • Cero atribuciones de IA o co-authored-by en los commits.

docs.title: 9. Motor de Eventos Custom (Zero-Overhead Dynamic Events)
docs.text:
Permite interceptar eventos de cualquier plugin de terceros (ej. torretas, jobs, dungeons) sin necesidad de agregar dependencias Maven en compilación:

  1. Resolución en Arranque: MethodHandleChain compila las rutas de métodos getter a MethodHandle de la JVM en el inicio del plugin.
  2. Cero Reflexión en Runtime: Durante el juego, la invocación de métodos se ejecuta a velocidad directa de bytecode sin llamar a Method.invoke().
  3. Registro Bukkit Nativo: DynamicEventRegistry conecta dinámicamente con Bukkit usando un EventExecutor de alta prioridad.

docs.title: 10. Pruebas y Verificación
docs.text:
El proyecto cuenta con 301 pruebas unitarias e integrales que garantizan: - Persistencia asíncrona segura con HikariCP y transacciones batch. - Ausencia de bloqueos o race conditions en el tick loop principal. - Integridad anti-dupe en GUIs e inmutabilidad de modelos de dominio.

docs.title: 🔌 Zero-Overhead Dynamic Custom Event Engine
docs.text: BlueHellStats features an event interception engine that allows you to hook and track events emitted by any 3rd-party plugin (e.g. custom turrets, slimefun machines, jobs, custom bosses) without having to add compile-time Maven dependencies.

docs.title: 🚀 Configuration Syntax (stats.yml)
docs.text:
Set event: CUSTOM and declare the custom_event_data block:

stats:
  turrets_placed:
    display-name: "<yellow>Turrets Placed</yellow>"
    event: CUSTOM
    increment: 1
    custom_event_data:
      event: "dt.ajneb97.api.TurretPlaceEvent"
      player_variable: "getPlayer()"
      variables_to_capture:
        - "%world%;getLocation().getWorld().getName()"
        - "%turret_type%;getTurretType()"
      conditions:
        - "%world% equals world"
        - "%turret_type% equals LASER"

docs.title: ⚙️ Configuration Properties
docs.text: Property Description Example event The fully-qualified Java class name of the event. "dt.ajneb97.api.TurretPlaceEvent" player_variable Method chain returning the Player performing the event. "getPlayer()" or "getEntity()" variables_to_capture List of <placeholder>;<getter_method_path>. "%world%;getLocation().getWorld().getName()" conditions Logic checks comparing captured placeholders. "%world% equals world", "%level% >= 5"

docs.title: ⚡ Technical Architecture: Why is it Lag-Free?
docs.text:
Traditional dynamic event reflection in Bukkit plugins uses java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(), which causes significant overhead and garbage allocation.

BlueHellStats eliminates this: 1. Boot Compilation via MethodHandleChain: During server startup or /bhe reload, the method paths (e.g. getLocation().getWorld().getName()) are parsed and compiled into high-performance java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles linked directly to the JVM call site. 2. Native Bukkit EventExecutor: The event listener registers directly into Bukkit's HandlerList via pluginManager.registerEvent(), bypassing heavy listener proxying. 3. Bytecode Invocation ($O(1)$): When the event fires, methods are invoked through pre-bound MethodHandle.invokeExact() / invoke(), running at near-native compiled Java speed.

docs.title: ⚙️ Database Configuration
docs.text: BlueHellStats provides an asynchronous database layer powered by HikariCP connection pooling and automatic schema migrations.

docs.title: 🗄️ Supported Database Engines
docs.text: Configure your storage engine in plugins/BlueHellEssence/config.yml:

    file: "bluehell.db"

docs.title: 2. MySQL / MariaDB (Multi-Server Network / Bungee / Velocity)
docs.text:
Ideal for networks hosted across multiple nodes or managed via phpMyAdmin/Pterodactyl.

  type: MYSQL # or MARIADB

    host: "127.0.0.1"
    port: 3306
    database: "network_stats"
    username: "minecraft"
    password: "your_strong_password"
    ssl: false

  flush-interval-seconds: 20
  leaderboard-refresh-seconds: 60
  leaderboard-top-size: 10

Recommended for massive network scale with ultra-low query latency and advanced connection pooling.

  type: POSTGRESQL
  postgresql:
    host: "10.0.0.5"
    port: 5432
    database: "network_stats"
    username: "postgres_user"
    password: "your_strong_password"
    ssl: false

docs.title: ⚡ Write-Behind Caching Architecture
docs.text: To guarantee that the Bukkit tick thread is never stalled: 1. In-Memory Mutations: When players break blocks, kill mobs, or trigger stats, their score delta is accumulated into a local concurrent RAM cache (dirtyDeltas) in nanoseconds. 2. Periodic Batch Flushing: Every flush-interval-seconds (default: 20s), an asynchronous background worker drains dirty deltas and sends batch SQL statements (executeBatch()) within a single database transaction. 3. Session Flush on Disconnect: When a player disconnects (PlayerQuitEvent), any pending uncommitted delta is immediately flushed asynchronously to ensure zero stat loss. 4. Clean Server Shutdown: On onDisable(), the plugin blocks gracefully until all pending database writes finish before closing the HikariCP connection pool.

docs.title: 🎨 GUI Customization & Anti-Dupe Architecture
docs.text: All user interfaces in BlueHellStats are declarative, customizable via YAML files inside plugins/BlueHellEssence/menus/, and built with enterprise-grade anti-dupe security.

docs.title: 🛡️ Anti-Dupe Security & HCI Design
docs.text:
Virtual menus in Minecraft can be susceptible to item duplication and ghost item glitches if poorly designed. BlueHellStats employs a multi-tiered security model:

  1. Priority Cancellation: All InventoryClickEvent and InventoryDragEvent occurrences in any plugin menu are cancelled at EventPriority.HIGHEST.
  2. Hotbar Swap & Injection Shield: Number key swaps (1-9), shift-clicks, off-hand swaps (F), and double-clicks are completely blocked.
  3. Macro Debouncing: An internal 150ms per-player debouncer prevents autoclicker race conditions during menu transitions.
  4. PDC Navigation Routing: Buttons store routing metadata in Paper's PersistentDataContainer (PDC), never relying on mutable item display names or lore.

docs.title: 💡 Architecture & Philosophy
docs.text: BlueHellStats is engineered following Pragmatic Clean Architecture: 1. The Bukkit Tick Loop (20 TPS) is Sacred: All disk I/O, network communication, database reads/writes, dirty delta flushes, and rank sortings are strictly offloaded to asynchronous background worker pools. 2. Immutability by Default: All domain entities are represented by immutable Java 21 Records (StatDefinition, PlayerProfile, LeaderboardEntry, PodiumConfig). 3. Hardened Security: Anti-dupe GUI pipelines cancel events at HIGHEST priority, blocking hotbar swapping, item injection, drag duplication, and macro spam. 4. Resilient Network Synchronization: Two-phase distributed lock barrier prevents race conditions and duplicate reward deliveries across multi-server proxy environments.

docs.title: 🚀 Quick Start Guide
docs.text: This guide walks you through installing and configuring BlueHellStats on a Paper 1.21+ server.

docs.title: 📋 Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Server Platform: Paper, Purpur, or any modern Paper fork running Minecraft 1.21.1+.
  • Java Runtime: Java 21 or newer (OpenJDK / Temurin 21 recommended).
  • Optional Integrations:
  • PlaceholderAPI (for chat, scoreboard, and tablist placeholders)
  • Citizens or FancyNpcs (for in-world 3D player podium NPCs)
  • DecentHolograms (for floating spawn leaderboard holograms)
  • WorldGuard (for region-specific stat tracking like PvP arenas)
  • Vault (for economy commands in seasonal rewards and milestones)

docs.title: 📦 Installation Steps
docs.text:
1. Download: Obtain the latest BlueHellEssence-1.3.0.jar from Releases.
  2. Deploy: Place the .jar into your server's plugins/ folder.
  3. Boot Server: Start your server once to allow BlueHellStats to create its configuration folder and default files: 
    plugins/BlueHellEssence/
├── config.yml
├── seasons.yml
├── stats.yml
├── podiums.yml
├── messages/
│   ├── messages_en.yml
│   └── messages_es.yml
└── menus/
    ├── hub.yml
    ├── top.yml
    └── profile.yml
  4. Choose Database: By default, BlueHellStats runs on SQLite (bluehell.db), requiring zero setup. If you run a network, see [[Database-Configuration]].
  5. Reload Configs: Run /bhe reload to apply any changes in real time without restarting the server.

docs.title: 🏆 Seasons & Tournaments Engine
docs.text: BlueHellStats includes a seasonal competition engine that automates tournament schedules, historical archiving, and safe reward distribution.

docs.title: 🔒 Two-Phase Rollover Barrier
docs.text: When a season expires (either automatically or via /season rollover): 1. Phase 1: Freeze & Distributed Lock: The coordinating node acquires a database-level distributed lock. Active score increments are temporarily frozen in RAM to ensure an uncorrupted snapshot. 2. Phase 2: Archive & Reward Queuing: The top players for each stat are immortalized into the bh_hall_of_fame table. Reward commands are queued into the bh_pending_rewards queue for Top 1, 2, and 3 players. 3. Phase 3: Activation & Resumption: A new active season ID is generated, stats for the new season are initialized, and live score increments resume.

docs.title: 🎁 Reward Delivery & Historical Browser
docs.text:
• Safe Delivery: Pending rewards are delivered via console commands when players log in (claim-on-join: true) or manually via /season claim.
  • Hall of Fame (/halloffame): Players can open an interactive GUI to browse winners, podium standings, and final scores of past seasons.

docs.title: 📊 Statistics Configuration (stats.yml)
docs.text: BlueHellStats allows you to declare unlimited dynamic statistics with granular condition filtering, permission multipliers, milestone rewards, and seasonal prizes.

docs.title: 🛠️ YAML Structure & Options
docs.text:
stats:
  <stat_id>:
    display-name: "<color>Display Name</color>"
    event: <EVENT_TYPE>
    increment: 1
    cooldown-ms: 0
    conditions:
      materials: [DIAMOND_ORE, DEEPSLATE_DIAMOND_ORE]
      entities: [PLAYER, ZOMBIE]
      game-modes: [SURVIVAL]
      ignore-silk-touch: true
      world-mode: WHITELIST # Options: WHITELIST or BLACKLIST
      worlds: [world, world_nether]
      regions: [arena_pvp] # WorldGuard region IDs
    multipliers:
      "bluehell.multiplier.vip": 2.0
      "bluehell.multiplier.mvp": 3.0
    milestones:
      - threshold: 100
        message: "<green>You reached 100 diamonds!</green>"
        broadcast: "<gold><player> reached 100 diamonds!</gold>"
        commands:
          - "give %player% diamond 5"
    season-rewards:
      1:
        - "eco give %player% 50000"
        - "broadcast <gold>[SEASON]</gold> <yellow>%player%</yellow> won Top 1!"
      2:
        - "eco give %player% 25000"
      3:
        - "eco give %player% 10000"

docs.text: Event Type Bukkit Trigger Event Supported Condition Filters BLOCK_BREAK BlockBreakEvent materials, ignore-silk-touch, game-modes, worlds, regions BLOCK_PLACE BlockPlaceEvent materials, game-modes, worlds, regions ENTITY_KILL EntityDeathEvent entities (e.g. PLAYER, ENDER_DRAGON), game-modes, worlds, regions ITEM_CRAFT CraftItemEvent materials, game-modes, worlds ITEM_CONSUME PlayerItemConsumeEvent materials, game-modes, worlds PLAYER_FISH PlayerFishEvent materials (caught item), game-modes, worlds CUSTOM Any Bukkit Event See [[Custom-Event-Engine]] for details

docs.title: 🧩 Composite Boolean Requirements
docs.text:
Define cross-stat requirements that can be evaluated dynamically in PlaceholderAPI (%bluehell_req_<id>%):

requirements:
  nether_champion:
    pvp_kills: 50
    diamonds_mined: 500
    blaze_kills: 100
When a player reaches or exceeds all threshold values, %bluehell_req_nether_champion% returns true.
